description: Works to trees covered by LBE ORDER NO 157: (T1) Hornbeam - crown lift to 5m above ground level, (T19) Oak - Crown lift to 5m above ground level, (T20) Oak - lateral crown reduce by 2m radius leaving a balanced crown.
decision_conditions: The proposed works would have a negative impact upon the trees long-term health, and the trees amenity value. In the absence of sufficient supporting evidence to demonstrate the necessity of the proposals, the stated reasons for the work are considered unjustified.
